name: Microlink
tagline: Unified API for URL metadata, screenshots, PDFs, and content extraction.
description: Microlink turns URLs into normalized metadata and can generate screenshots, PDFs, HTML, Markdown, text, media, and structured data. Its REST API uses GET requests through two endpoints: api.microlink.io for unauthenticated free use and pro.microlink.io for authenticated plans.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header or apiKey query parameter; free tier works without a key with lower limits. Self-serve signup at microlink.io.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 25 requests/day on the unauthenticated public endpoint (approximately 1,500/month); no credit card required.
pricing.paid_plans: Pro and custom plans available; see microlink.io/pricing

rate_limits: Free: soft limit of 25 requests/day, resetting daily, with limited/shared concurrency. Pro: unlimited daily quota and 46,000–420,000 requests/month. Enterprise: millions+. Quota exhaustion returns HTTP 429 with code ERATE.

example.response_snippet: {"status":"success","data":{"title":"Wormholes Explained – Breaking Spacetime","description":"Are wormholes real or are they just magic disguised as physics and maths?...","lang":"en","publisher":"YouTube","url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9P6rdqiybaw"}}

use_cases: fetch Open Graph and meta tags for a URL
generate a screenshot of a web page
create a PDF from a URL
extract structured content from an article
build rich link previews in an app
